name: Nezabytye
source:
“Unforgotten” is a visual novel inspired by the myths of the Northern peoples of Russia with elements of horror and a fascinating and confusing story about how a simple student from Moscow, seeking to learn the secrets of his past, looks into the future. 

The game is based on the story of a small mining village hidden in the forest. Strange and sometimes frightening rituals, unexpected discoveries, battles and, of course, love are waiting for him. Will Oleg be able to survive, reveal all the secrets of the past and not lose himself in the present? It depends only on you!
translation:
《Unforgotten》是一部受到俄罗斯北方民族神话启发的视觉小说，包含恐怖元素，以及引人入胜、扑朔迷离的故事。一名来自莫斯科的普通学生，为了了解自己的过去，竟窥见了未来。

故事围绕森林深处的一座小矿村展开。古怪而有时令人恐惧的仪式、意外的发现、战斗，以及爱情，都在等待着他。奥列格能否活下来，揭开过去的一切秘密，又不在当下迷失自己？完全取决于你！
